title: Truly optimal low rank thin plate spline smoothing using a truncated Demmler-Reinsch basis
summary: Thin plate splines are highly attractive smoothers. However, they have cubic computational cost, which severely limits their use in practice. As a remedy, Wood (2003) suggested thin plate regression splines (TPRS), which provide a low rank approximation. The key step of the TPRS approximation is a truncated eigendecomposition of the radial basis function (RBF) design matrix. However, as Wood (2003) writes, the optimality of the TPRS approximation is a slightly weak one.
